F(p): the number of infinite sequences specified in the theorem statement
a_n: the nth term of a sequence counted by F(p)
F_p: the field of residue classes modulo p
F_p^times: the set of nonzero elements of F_p
x: the initial value a_1, viewed as an element of F_p^times
y: the initial value a_2, viewed as an element of F_p^times
